title: Inefficient Resource Utilization in Spark Job
description: A Spark job is running but not utilizing the cluster resources efficiently, leading to increased execution time.

problemStatement.incident: Spark job exhibits poor performance due to inefficient resource allocation.
problemStatement.situation: A Spark job has been deployed to process a large dataset, but it is observed that the execution time is unusually long. Initial diagnostics suggest that the job is not utilizing the cluster's CPU and memory resources optimally.
tasks: Check the Spark UI for resource utilization statistics.
Identify any misconfigurations in the Spark job's resource allocation settings.
Propose improvements to the Spark configuration.
problemStatement.scoring: The fix is considered valid if the job's execution time is reduced by at least 40% without increasing the allocated resources.
